token.title: 🔑 Token blong GitHub
token.intro: GitHub i ansa 60 rikwes long wan aoa long wan adres we i no sendem token. Wan ful tri blong fok i kosem samwe 32, ale long seken visit i no moa gat. Wan token i leftemap limit i go 5000 long wan aoa.
token.step1: Openem Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, afta Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: akaon blong yu. Expiration: eni deit, tri i no nidim wan samting we i stap longtaem.
token.step4: No tajem eni pemisen. Pablik infomesen blong ripo i no nidim wan long olgeta.
token.step5: Mekem, afta kopi valiu blong {token}. GitHub i soem wan taem nomo.
token.classic: Wan olfala token i wok tu: mekem wan we i no gat eni skop. Wan skop we i emti i save ridim pablik infomesen long spid blong man we i saen-in.
token.stays: Hem i stap long brausa ia anda long ki {key} mo i go long {host} nomo. Oli neva raetem long adres ba, ale wan link we yu serem i karem luk, i no karem pasword. Baten anda long filed i rabem aot bakegen wetem kas.
token.persistHow: Putum token long fael {env} blong seva we i holem pej ia, klosap long {port}:
token.proxy: mo statem wetem {make}. Afta, kontena i raetem wan smol pis blong nginx we i joenem heda {header} long wan proksi {path}, ale brausa i kolem ples blong hem wan mo i neva kasem token. Filed ia i lus mo evri visita i serem wan limit blong 5000 long wan aoa.

fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub i no moa gat rikwes long aoa ia, ale i no save droem ol laen blong brens. Netwok blong fok antap i ful. Putum wan token long panel blong filta, o tanem i of ol laen blong brens long panel blong luk blong yusum limit long netwok nomo.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub i ansa {status} long histri blong ol komit, ale i no save droem ol laen blong brens. Netwok blong fok antap i ful.
